alt: February 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of pink cherry blossom branches against a splash of blue sky. Shivratri is marked.
caption: A watercolor calendar page for February 2025 featuring a branch of pink blossoms on a blue wash
description: A branch of pink cherry blossoms and small buds on woody twigs is painted in a soft watercolor style against an irregular wash of blue and light blue. Below the artwork the word FEBRUARY and the year 2025 label a grid of days of the week and dates, with one date marked with a festival name. A small pink logo reading studio91 sits in the upper right corner.
